lead: Each entry has an icon, the discount and one line on how to prove eligibility. Naming the proof saves readers from having to ask.
note: The note holds the rules for all programmes: whether they combine, what they apply to and how long they last.

programmes.title: The title states the discount
programmes.text: Readers see the amount without opening anything.

programmes.title: The proof is named
programmes.text: Say which document to send and where. That answers the question before anyone asks.

programmes.title: A card can be a link
programmes.text: Then the whole card is clickable, and the title names the link for screen readers.

programmes.title: Two to four columns
programmes.text: The grid adapts to the space it has, not to the screen width.
